Built from VP-D0's validated projection by VP-1\queries\build_fixture.py. Read by the VP-1 frontend tests and scripts/_instruments/mint_hvac_v66_valve.py (test_valve_v66 proves the asset equals it). `_boq` on an item = the ruled sheet's BoQ supply / install (identity).

attribute_definitions.label: Valve type
attribute_definitions.note: Which valve or valve-type item THIS row buys. Butterfly Valve = a manual (lever / gear) butterfly valve; Motorised Butterfly Valve = a butterfly valve with an electric / motorised actuator; Balancing Valve = a balancing valve, DRV, double regulating or commissioning set; NRV / Check Valve = any non-return, check or reflux valve; PIBCV = a pressure independent (balancing) control valve, PICV or PIBCV; Sluice / Gate Valve = a sluice or gate valve; Strainer = any strainer; Ball Valve = a ball valve, and a drain valve or drain cock; Test & Drain Valve = only where the row says 'test and drain' valve; Foot Valve = a foot valve; Automatic Air Vent = an automatic air vent / air release / air purger; BTU Meter = a BTU, heat or thermal energy meter; 2-Way Valve = a 2-way (motorised) control valve that is not pressure independent. A thermometer, temperature or pressure gauge, test plug / point, thermowell, rubber bellows, flexible connection or expansion joint is NOT a valve: return it as its own item in the misc section. Answer 'none of these' for any other valve or instrument (a flow meter, a 3-way valve, a pot strainer, a gauge cock, an isolation valve with no type, a valve whose type is not written) and copy its words into 'Valve type as written'. Return one item per valve or instrument the row pays for: a valve named with gauges, a thermometer or another valve is several items. A part built into the valve (its actuator, its flanges, its handle) is never a second item. The row's own text wins over a heading; take the type from a heading only when it describes this row's item (a size-only row under 'Butterfly valves').

attribute_definitions.label: Valve type as written
attribute_definitions.note: The valve or instrument's type in the BoQ's OWN WORDS, from the row, else from the nearest heading that describes this row's item. Copy the words exactly as the BoQ writes them, as one continuous piece; never shorten, never join pieces with '...' or any other mark; if the words are long, copy the shortest continuous piece that holds the value.

attribute_definitions.label: Valve size
attribute_definitions.note: The valve's own size AS THE ROW WRITES IT, with its unit: mm, an NB number (50 NB), DN 50, inches (1-1/2", 2 inch). Never converted, never rounded. A dial size of a gauge or thermometer, a pressure rating (PN 16), a pipe schedule or an insulation thickness is NEVER the valve size. Where the row names two sizes for this item copy both as written (25/32 mm). Copy the words exactly as the BoQ writes them, as one continuous piece; never shorten, never join pieces with '...' or any other mark; if the words are long, copy the shortest continuous piece that holds the value.

attribute_definitions.label: Actuator duty
attribute_definitions.note: Motorised butterfly valves only: On-Off or Modulating, as the row or a heading describing this valve states. 'None' when not stated.

attribute_definitions.label: 2-way operation
attribute_definitions.note: 2-way valves only: On-Off or Modulating as stated. 'None' when not stated.

attribute_definitions.label: NRV type
attribute_definitions.note: NRV / check valves only: Dual Plate, Ball Type, Wafer, or Flanged (a swing / flanged NRV). 'None' when the row names no NRV type; flanges named only as companion flanges are not a type.

attribute_definitions.label: Spindle
attribute_definitions.note: Sluice / gate valves only: Rising or Non-rising spindle as stated. 'None' when not stated.

attribute_definitions.label: Strainer type
attribute_definitions.note: Strainers only: Y-Type or T-Type as stated. 'None' when not stated (a pot / basket strainer is 'none of these' in Valve type).

attribute_definitions.label: Flanged
attribute_definitions.note: Yes when the row, or a heading describing this valve, says the valve is flanged or comes with companion / matching flanges. 'None' when not mentioned.

attribute_definitions.label: Operator as written
attribute_definitions.note: Butterfly valves: the operator the BoQ names (lever, hand lever, gear, gear box, worm gear), copied as written. Copy the words exactly as the BoQ writes them, as one continuous piece; never shorten, never join pieces with '...' or any other mark; if the words are long, copy the shortest continuous piece that holds the value.

attribute_definitions.label: Quantity in one row unit
attribute_definitions.note: How many of THIS item make one unit of the row, only where the row states a count for this item ('with 2 nos pressure gauges' -> 2 on the gauge item). 'None' otherwise. Never the row's own quantity, a size or a dial size.

attribute_definitions.label: Scope
attribute_definitions.note: What the row pays for, from its own words first, then a heading describing it: supply + installation (SITC, supply & install, fixing ...), supply only, or installation only. 'None' when nothing is said.
